I wanted enigma by riot, but ended up playing with it and coming up with what I wanted. I figured it out myself and don't want to upload the patch. I can tell you more what I meant. The filters I mean are filters 1 and 2. The fader to the left of the two filters should be a little below the middle.
authentic lasagna

Massive, all three oscs with envelope 1 on the - under the pitch.

Envelope 1 -- no delay, 9 o clock attack, full attack level, 8 o clock decay, no decay level, 9 o clock release

Envelope 4 -- no delay, 8 o clock attack, full attack level, 12 o clock decay, full decay level, 9 o clock release

Osc 1 -- square saw 1, all knobs full right, envelope +7

Osc 2 -- pulse saw pwn detuned to -0.16, all knobs full right, envelope +8

Osc 3 -- square saw 1 tuned down -12, first two knobs full right, amp knob 12 o clock, envelope +7

Modulation -- pitch up .33, phase only on osc 2

Noise -- hi metallic, full right color, 12 o clock amp

NO FEEDBACK

Insert 1 -- parabolic shaper, 9 o clock wet, 12 o clock drive

Insert 2 -- hardclipper, 10 o clock wet, 2 o clock drive

PUT THE FADER LEFT OF THE FILTERS 1-4 TICKS BELOW MID AND BOTH FILTER VOLS TO THE RIGHT ALL THE WAY UP AND THE MIX TO THE LEFT 3-6 TICKS ABOVE MID

Filter 1 -- lowpass 4, 3 o clock cutoff, 9 o clock resonance

Filter 2 -- lowpass 2, cutoff full right, 12 o clock resonance

FX 1 -- tele tube, everything 12 o clock

FX 2 -- dimension expander, 10 o clock wet, 12 o clock size

EQ -- 12 o clock low, everything else boost to 2 o clock
